description.value: The study used fMRI to examine brain activation elicited by alcohol cues, differences between AUD and control participants, and associations between alcohol-cue activation and craving.

spans.text: This study's purpose was to identify the neural substrates and mechanisms responsible for craving among subjects with alcohol use disorders (AUDs) using functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI).

description.value: Observational, two-group fMRI study of nine participants with AUD and nine controls.
